item.title: Research Interests
item.description: I aim develop computational frameworks for spatial perturbation modeling—methods that integrate single-cell, spatial, and perturbation data to uncover how cellular neighborhoods respond to genetic or chemical interventions. Broadly, my work focuses on building technologies that accelerate the discovery and design of new therapeutics, bridging molecular insight and spatial and temporal contexts to advance our understanding of human health and disease.
